caption: The drawing consists of a large square filled with a dense, repeating pattern of small, three-sided cubical shapes resembling isometric cubes arranged in a tight, grid-like composition. Each cube is colored with combinations of blue, yellow, green, red, orange, pink, purple, black, and brown, creating a multicolored mosaic effect. The palette is varied, with some areas dominated by blues and greens and others by reds, oranges, and yellows, while the cubes are outlined in black. Near the lower left part of the square, there is a white rhombus or diamond shape that overlaps the pattern; inside the diamond, there is handwritten text in a brownish color. The entire patterned square sits on a plain, uncolored background.
title: Silk Patchwork Quilt
